description: Verify that the Message Type of the notification is 0x02 (NOTIFICATION)
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: Message Type must equal 0x02 (NOTIFICATION). The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's Message Type == 0x02 (NOTIFICATION)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Message Type on the wire equals 0x02 (NOTIFICATION).

[Fail condition]
• Fail_message_type — Message type not 0x02
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
